name: AnyAPI
description: Unified marketplace for scraping and data APIs: one key, one USD wallet, 363 APIs through a single normalized interface with automatic failover.

signup.description: Free trial key for agents - no human sign-in, no account created. POST to mint an aa_live_ trial key instantly (returned once) with about $0.05 of requests; if never upgraded it self-expires in 7 days, so nothing lingers and nothing is owed. When the trial budget is spent, calls return HTTP 402 trial_cap_reached with an upgrade link; agents with the CLI run "anyapi connect" (OAuth, one consent URL) so the human can approve continued spend.

cli.recommendedFor: agents with a shell (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex); keeps tool schemas out of context and writes results to files
commands: anyapi connect (anyapi-cli >= 0.3.0; upgrade past the trial via OAuth)

mcp.recommendedFor: hosted Claude, ChatGPT, and other clients without a shell; connect by URL and complete OAuth

contextControls.description: Optional run_api parameters that shrink the response to fit an agent context window. They do not change what is charged.
